Summary.title: Professional Summary
Summary.headline: Exploring web and cloud-native apps development.
Summary.subtext: I'm a Computer Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in full-stack development, cloud-native applications, and technical support. I've worked with Golang, React, and Google Cloud, and have solid understanding of Agile practices, CI/CD, and software design. I'm currently focused on improving my skills in web development and cloud-native application development. I'm actively seeking for entry-level or junior software development roles where I can contribute, learn, and continue to grow as a developer.

ProjectsHero.title: Featured Projects
ProjectsHero.subtext: A few selected projects from the many I have worked on, reflecting my skills, interests, and approach to problem-solving.

ArboML.name: ArboML
ArboML.description: ArboML is a responsive, modern web application built to showcase services and capture client inquiries for a local arborist services business. It focuses on performance, accessibility, and a seamless user experience across devices.

features.first: Responsive frontend built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript for a consistent cross-device experience.
features.second: Serverless contact form powered by Firebase Cloud Functions and Nodemailer for handling client inquiries.
features.third: Deployed on Vercel for fast, reliable performance and easy scalability.

Cloudtail.name: Cloudtail
Cloudtail.description: Cloudtail is a lightweight, cloud-native CLI built in Go that enables real-time querying and streaming of logs from Google Cloud Logging. It helps streamline debugging by providing fast, filter-based log retrieval directly from the terminal.

features.first: Stream logs in real time and query historical logs from Google Cloud Logging.
features.second: Filter logs by severity, resource type, and time range for precise debugging.
features.third: Output logs to the terminal or a file for flexible analysis.

urlShortener.name: URL Shortener
urlShortener.description: A lightweight, serverless URL Shortener built with Go and Google Cloud technologies. It enables users to generate compact, shareable links while seamlessly handling redirection and usage tracking through a modern serverless architecture.

features.first: Create short URLs that redirect to original links.
features.second: Store and manage URL data and metadata using Cloud Firestore.
features.third: Track usage with click counts recorded for each short URL.

goWeather.name: Go Weather
goWeather.description: go-weather is a lightweight CLI tool built with Go that delivers real-time weather data and extended forecasts for locations worldwide. It leverages the spf13/cobra library to provide a fast, intuitive command-line experience

features.first: Retrieve current weather conditions and forecasts up to 16 days ahead.
features.second: Query weather data by city name or ZIP/postal code, with optional country filtering.
features.third: Customize output with unit selection (Celsius or Fahrenheit) for flexible usage.
